text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — High 5xx rate observed for HelioDynamics (private VPC). NLB target group shows 0/3 healthy, last healthcheck failures 03:12:14 UTC. Incident INC-2026-0317-03. https://console.redwood/incident/INC-2026-0317-03

mike: I'm on it. Escalating to network oncall @sanjay. Can someone pull target group and host health?

sanjay: Looking at the NLB target status -> 0/3 healthy, last response from targets: 502 Bad Gateway. No recent SG changes in CloudTrail for the account.

jess: Handing off to eng oncall in 2. @oncall-ing-nyc please take ownership for mitigation and customer comms.

oncall-ing-nyc: taking it. First steps: confirm app health endpoint from inside the VPC and check conntrack + NAT metrics.

oncall-ing-nyc: ssh jump@helio-bastion && curl -v http://10.0.3.14:8080/health

oncall-ing-nyc: curl output: 
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
Content-Type: text/plain

error: upstream connect error or disconnect.

carla: HelioDynamics CS says their inference UI is returning errors for all requests since ~03:12 UTC — customer impact: inference requests failing (web + API).

sanjay: checked host metrics: conntrack entries near limit on hosts (nf_conntrack_count ~ 255k / nf_conntrack_max 262144). NAT gateway reported spike in ephemeral ports. No CPU/mem pressure.

mike: timeline check: any deploys around 03:00?

eng-releases-bot: Deploy helio-infer v3.4.1 -> v3.5.0 at 02:58:12 UTC (release id rel-2026-0317-07).

oncall-ing-nyc: That aligns. Hypothesis: client change + keepalive behavior + NAT/conntrack exhaustion causing upstream failures, healthchecks to backend returning 502. Mitigation plan: 1) free/bump conntrack on hosts, 2) set NLB healthcheck to fallback to internal standby ALB (weight-based), 3) ask customer to throttle burst while we stabilize.

sre-lead: Agreed. Quick fix = bump nf_conntrack_max and add temporary iptables conntrack timeout tweaks. Follow-up = add autoscaling for conntrack or host pool, add release canary gate.

oncall-ing-nyc: Executing: sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288 && sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=86400

oncall-ing-nyc: After change: nf_conntrack_count dropped as kernel reclaimed entries, targets now report 3/3 healthy. NLB healthchecks returning 200.

mike: Confirm app-level checks: curl http://10.0.3.14:8080/health -> 200 OK, body: {"status":"ok","uptime":"00:09:12"}  :thumbsup:

carla: Notifying HelioDynamics: initial message sent — service degraded but currently being mitigated; will follow with RCA.

sanjay: Additional note: NAT gateway ephemeral port exhaustion observed in account metrics. Raised task to add NAT autoscaling + EIP pool review.

sre-lead: Postmortem action items:
- Add conntrack autoscaling playbook and monitoring alert (SLO: conntrack > 75% triggers runway alert).
- Add release canary for helio-infer with traffic shaping for private VPCs.
- Add NLB healthcheck fallback to standby ALB for quick failover.
- Review customer-side keepalive/connection patterns in integration doc.

mike: Closing incident in system. Incident INC-2026-0317-03 resolved at 4623456840. Will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> resolved. Tags: private-vpc, nlb, conntrack, nat, customer-impact

carla: Customer acknowledged restoration and requested timeline for RCA. I'll own follow-up comms.

jess: Nice fast mitigation team. Please add runbook snippets to eng-runbooks repo before EOD.

oncall-ing-nyc: Will create PR for runbook changes and link incident. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
